Two-model ranking audit shows top-model flips versus random split in 3 Mojahid protocols, 0 TIGPR protocols and 1 Zenodo protocols. Five-seed split-stability audit adds 100 local runs with largest mean random-minus-protocol BA gaps of +0.1472 for Mojahid, +0.0652 for TIGPR and +0.2796 for Zenodo and +0.1224 for DeepMask/GPR_data. Five-family split matrix adds 100 local model/protocol runs and top-model flip counts of 0 for Mojahid, 0 for TIGPR and 4 for Zenodo and 4 for DeepMask/GPR_data. Exact sign/sign-flip statistics over unified split contrasts show 15/16 positive contrasts, sign p=0.0003 and mean sign-flip p=0.0000. TIGPR duplicate-aware sweep confirms hash-group split has zero shared duplicate groups and random-minus-group HOG balanced-accuracy delta=+0.0537. The TIGPR duplicate model-family matrix shows 4/5 directional support and 4/5 material support.
remaining_gap: None for local sample-level asset inventory; blind external validation remains separate.

basis: Res-SAM mean/std alignment improved balanced accuracy in both transfer directions (+0.0267, +0.1267). Mojahid mean/std alignment also improved balanced accuracy under both grouped protocols (+0.0124, +0.0084). Train-only gradient-reversal repair at lambda=1.0 reduced processing-role domain BA by -0.0567 with target BA change -0.0004; under the task-aware protocol the domain BA change was -0.0508 with target BA change -0.0053. Non-transductive per-image zscore was nearly neutral (+0.0033, -0.0022); source-side style augmentation was negative in both transfer directions (-0.0100, -0.0111); 4TU Land type alignment was negative on balanced accuracy for mean/std and CORAL (-0.1095, -0.0429). Mojahid train-only source reweighting did not improve balanced accuracy; source-balanced deltas were -0.0143 and -0.0244. Mojahid validation-only temperature calibration reduced ECE (-0.1355, -0.0910) without changing balanced accuracy. Mojahid train-only source-direction residualization using is_augmented source signal reduced source-probe BA (-0.0737, -0.0812) but also reduced target BA (-0.0865, -0.1403). Mojahid group-DRO repair adds source_group, label-source_group and processing-role robust optimization; source_group DRO target BA deltas were -0.0178 and -0.0066, while processing-role DRO deltas were +0.0018 and +0.0025. CORAL remains mixed, simple train-time reweighting should not be treated as a repair winner, calibration only fixes confidence, naive source residualization shows a source-performance trade-off, and group-DRO gives only tiny processing-role gains.
remaining_gap: Repair is not a universal positive result: target-statistic alignment helps on Res-SAM/Mojahid, but strict non-transductive variants, 4TU alignment, Mojahid train-only reweighting, source-group DRO and naive source residualization do not show stable target gains; calibration improves ECE only.
